equal_raw_column_cap_rationale: Capping M1 to M0's column count would handicap the feature universe under test; fairness is enforced by an identical penalised-selection regime instead.
grouped_shrinkage_removed_in_v2: v1 declared grouped shrinkage over structural families without a group penalty or solver, leaving the executor free to choose one and making it the only declared machinery difference between arms. v2 removes it before any execution or outcome access; elastic net under an identical grid and nested chronological CV is the penalised-selection control.
